# ADVISOR

## Advanced Detection Via Integrated Sensors for Operational Resilience

**Empowering researchers and practitioners with data-driven solutions.**

ADVISOR combines sensing and analytics systems to study multimodal transportation, human behavior, and environmental conditions in real-world settings. Our work brings together computer vision, wearable devices, environmental sensing, and data analytics to generate actionable insights for safer, more efficient, and more resilient transportation systems.

[Explore Projects](projects.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Contact Us](contact.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

## Key Focus Areas

:::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-3 .card-box}
### Evidence-Based Planning
Transportation planning supported by high-resolution multimodal data and analytics.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-3 .card-box}
### Safety Risk Identification
Detection of conflict zones, near misses, and operational safety risks.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-3 .card-box}
### Operational Efficiency
Analysis of access, circulation, curbside use, dwell time, and movement patterns.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-3 .card-box}
### Human Experience
Integration of stress, environmental exposure, and behavioral data into transport policy.
:::
::::

## Featured Projects

:::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .project-card}
### Traffic Mobility: Medical Center Drive
Multimodal activity analysis using computer vision to identify peak demand patterns, safety risks, and high-resolution trajectory and count data.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .project-card}
### Curbside Management: Sarratt Circle
Analysis of curbside violations, dwell times, and operational conflicts affecting transit and access.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .project-card}
### Pedestrian Stress Study
Wearable sensor-based analysis of stress in real environments to support human-centered infrastructure design.
:::
